patterns: How do I return an item?
How long do I have to return something?
responses: We offer a 30-day return policy for most items in their original condition and packaging. You will need your receipt or invoice. Refunds will be issued to the original payment method.
You can return items within 30 days of purchase. Simply bring the product and receipt to any store location or start a return online via your account portal.

patterns: How can I track my package?
I haven't received my order yet
responses: You can track your order using the tracking number sent to your email. Alternatively, log into your account and check the 'My Orders' section.
Please check the shipment tracking link in your confirmation email or provide me with your Order ID so I can look it up.

patterns: What payment methods do you accept?
Can I pay with Apple Pay?
responses: We accept all major credit and debit cards (Visa, MasterCard, Amex), Apple Pay, Google Pay, PayPal, and store gift cards.
We support Visa, MasterCard, American Express, PayPal, Apple Pay, and Google Pay. Cash on delivery is also available for select pin codes.

patterns: How do I join the rewards club?
responses: Our Smart Retail Rewards program is free! You earn 1 point for every $1 spent. Points can be redeemed for discounts on future purchases. Sign up on our website or at checkout in-store.
Join our Loyalty Program to earn points on every purchase, get early access to sales, and receive exclusive member-only discount coupons.
